correctness.rationale: For every r>0 and tau in 1..4, a complete eight-mask birth-death transition matrix defines the model. The six transient backward equations have unique solutions because a connected graph gives a positive-probability path to absorption in at most two updates. The exact coefficient arrays were checked against the independent standard-library Fraction solver at 30/58/86/114 distinct positive integer r values. Each candidate cross-multiplication polynomial has proved degree <=28*tau+1, so these exact checks prove identities for all real r, not merely finite sampling. Independently checked polynomial identities give strictly negative S1/S2, positive S4, and S3=r^5H(r+r^-1-2) where H(0)<0 and all higher coefficients are positive, yielding exactly one threshold. A separate degree-bound certificate establishes the static path formula. Boundaries r=1 and reciprocal r*, phase alignment and graph labels are explicit; no unsupported tau>=5 generalization is made. Evidence: verify.py, COEFFICIENTS.txt, RESULT.md.

value.rationale: A natural unresolved structural boundary is whether temporal switching can turn two individually amplifying networks into a suppressor, and at which switching duration the effect reverses. Three vertices are minimal for distinct connected simple unweighted networks. The theorem supplies an exact counterexample for two individually amplifying paths, universal suppressor signs for one/two steps, a single sharp selection-intensity crossover at three steps, and universal amplification at four. This is a qualitative phase diagram with an exact natural threshold, not an arbitrary small numerical table; it does not claim broader block-length coverage. A prior three-vertex star+triangle example is credited and differs because one constituent is neutral.
